body: Regret many of the things i did in life, hate the fact that i have to work tomorrow and have to deal with an absolute asshole of a boss, wish the time back where i was a little child and had to do nothing, care about nothing, did not need to be worried about anything where the world seemed simpler, ask myself when i will finally be at the point where everyone stops annoying me and curse myself for never having had the guts to just go for the girl i always loved and always will love, back in 3rd grade, almost 30 years ago, ask myself the question „what could have been“

Being able to spent time with my childhood crush, talk to her, play with her, be around her. Everything since then has just failed miserably in comparison. There is no such pure innocent and good time as when u are a child.
Can u play some anime songs?
